title: Payment authorisation failures
alert_or_symptom: Customers are unable to complete card payments.

technical_evidence.observation: Success rate fell from 97 percent to 4 percent at 10:15.
Requests to the external payment gateway return HTTP 503.
The local payment application and transaction database are healthy.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Customers using card payments cannot complete purchases.

environmental_context: The Payment Processing Service depends on the External Payment Gateway.
The local payment application and database are currently healthy.
reported_unknowns: The geographical scope has not been confirmed.
No approved payment workaround has yet been confirmed.
